presets.name: Noir (B&W, high contrast)
presets.prompt: Film noir look: convert to black & white with deep blacks, strong contrast, subtle film grain, and a slight vignette. Keep faces natural and preserve all details. Do not add text, logos, or watermarks.

presets.name: Cinematic (teal & orange grade)
presets.prompt: Apply a cinematic teal-and-orange color grade. Preserve skin tones, avoid oversaturation, keep fine texture and details. Do not add any text, logos, or frames.

presets.name: Vintage 35mm film
presets.prompt: Make this look like a vintage 35mm film photo: slightly faded colors, gentle halation, fine film grain, soft highlight roll-off. Keep it realistic and preserve details. No text or watermarks.

presets.name: Editorial fashion (clean, glossy)
presets.prompt: Editorial fashion retouch + grade: clean, glossy, high-end magazine look. Preserve identity, keep skin texture (no plastic skin), controlled highlights, neutral background if present. No text, no logos.

presets.name: Minimal poster
presets.prompt: Turn this into a minimal graphic poster style while preserving the main subject silhouette and key details. Use a simple limited palette, clean shapes, and a balanced composition. Do not add any typography or logos.

presets.name: Swiss / International Typographic Style (no text)
presets.prompt: Swiss/International Typographic Style look WITHOUT adding text: strict grid feeling, clean geometry, lots of negative space, crisp edges, modern minimal color palette. Keep the subject recognizable. No typography, no logos.

presets.name: Bauhaus geometric
presets.prompt: Apply a Bauhaus-inspired geometric design look: simple shapes, bold blocks of primary/neutral colors, strong composition. Preserve the subject in a stylized but recognizable way. Do not add text or logos.

presets.name: Art Deco glam (no text)
presets.prompt: Art Deco inspired treatment: elegant geometry, symmetrical accents, metallic gold/bronze highlights (subtle), rich blacks, glamorous lighting. Keep the original subject and details. No text or logos.

presets.name: Risograph / print grain
presets.prompt: Risograph print look: limited ink palette (2–3 colors), visible print grain, slight misregistration, paper texture. Keep subject clear and preserve details. Do not add text or watermarks.

presets.name: Y2K chrome pop
presets.prompt: Y2K-inspired pop look: glossy highlights, chrome-like accents, vibrant but controlled colors. Keep the original subject and preserve facial identity. Do not add any text, logos, or watermarks.

presets.name: Retro 80s neon
presets.prompt: Retro 80s neon aesthetic: magenta/cyan lighting vibe, subtle glow, deep shadows, synthwave feel. Preserve the scene and subject. No text or logos.

presets.name: Soft pastel dreamy
presets.prompt: Soft pastel dreamy look: airy highlights, gentle contrast, pastel toning, subtle bloom. Preserve details and keep it tasteful (not washed out). No text or watermarks.

presets.name: Brutalist poster (no text)
presets.prompt: Brutalist graphic design look without adding text: harsh contrast, raw textures, asymmetric layout feel, bold shapes, utilitarian palette. Preserve the subject and key details. No typography/logos/watermarks.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.prompt: Create a duotone version of this image using two well-chosen colors (dark + light). Keep the subject recognizable and preserve edges/details. No text, no logos.

presets.name: Sticker cutout (no text)
presets.prompt: Make the main subject a clean sticker cutout: accurate silhouette, subtle outline, slight drop shadow, clean background. Preserve details (hair, edges). Do not add any text or logos.

presets.name: Polaroid-style frame (no text)
presets.prompt: Present the photo inside a tasteful Polaroid-style frame: off-white paper border, slight shadow, mild film tone. Do not write any caption text on the border. Preserve the photo content.

presets.name: Merge selection into a clean collage grid
presets.prompt: Create a clean collage grid from all provided photos. Keep each photo recognizable (no heavy stylization), balance sizes, align edges, use consistent spacing, and a neutral background. Do NOT add text, dates, stickers, or watermarks.

presets.name: Double exposure (two images)
presets.prompt: Create a tasteful double-exposure by blending the first two provided images. Preserve the main subject silhouette, keep it realistic and clean, avoid muddy midtones. No text, no logos, no watermark.

presets.name: Contact sheet / storyboard (no text)
presets.prompt: Arrange all provided images into a contact-sheet / storyboard grid: consistent margins, subtle border lines, clean neutral background. Do not add frame numbers or text labels. Preserve each image content.

presets.name: Brand moodboard (no text)
presets.prompt: Create a clean brand moodboard from the provided images: balanced layout, cohesive spacing, consistent color feel. Do NOT add any text labels. Preserve each image’s key content.
